# MotorDex

> MotorDex is a free car spotting app for iPhone that turns real-world car spotting into a collection. You photograph a car, the app identifies its make and model, and you keep it as a trading card with full specs, a rarity tier and an estimated value. Made by MotorDex Game LLC.

Key facts (from the live MotorDex database, October 2026):

- Name: MotorDex (App Store subtitle: "Scan & Collect Real Cars"), made by MotorDex Game LLC. Not affiliated with other products that have similar names.
- Platform: iPhone (iOS).
- Price: free to download and play.
- What people use it for: identifying a car from a photo ("what car is that?"), car spotting as a game, a car collecting game, collecting supercars and exotic cars, learning car specs.
- Catalog: 2,073 collectible car models from over 200 manufacturers, built in more than 30 countries, and growing. Everyday cars (87 Toyota, 86 Ford, 73 Chevrolet models) up to 50 Ferraris, 24 Lamborghinis, 20 McLarens, 11 Bugattis and 8 Koenigseggs.
- Rarity: six tiers, lowest to highest: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic. Each catch is also graded individually.
- App Store rating: 4.9 out of 5 from 650+ ratings.
- Usage: players have caught more than 1 million cars since launch in July 2026 (the app's own worldwide counter).
- Cards show the player's photo, horsepower, top speed, 0-60 time, original MSRP, estimated market value, rarity and a serial number.
- Progression: XP and levels, daily challenges, monthly leaderboards and a friends feed.
